November 5, 2024

# Remove `metafieldDelete` in favor of `metafieldsDelete`

DateNovember 5, 2024

Version[2025-01](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2025-01)

Flags[Deprecation announcement](https://shopify.dev/changelog?filter=deprecation-announcement)[Action required](https://shopify.dev/changelog?action_required=true)

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of `2025-01` the `metafieldDelete` Admin API method is being removed. The `metafieldsDelete` method should be used instead. The former relies on the Metafield GID, while the latter takes an array of Metafield Identifiers composed of `ownerId`, `namespace`, and `key`. Note that the Metafield GID is not an option in `metafieldsDelete`.
